nodes.name: Error Trigger
nodes.notes: Catches failures from any workflow that lists this workflow in Settings → Error Workflow. Also set as instance default Error Workflow in n8n Settings.

nodes.name: Forward to Incident Router
nodes.notes: Set INCIDENT_ROUTER_WEBHOOK_URL to the Incident Router workflow Production webhook URL.

meta.description: Global n8n error handler. Assign as Error Workflow on all TenderScope workflows. Forwards incidents to Incident Router.
